# noozle_amqp_1_outlet (Data Source)

Reads a Noozle AMQP 1.0 outlet by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

data "noozle_amqp_1_outlet" "alerts" {
  id = 123
}
```
